name: Falling Out Of Love
overview: Scripture reveals that falling out of love, particularly in marriage, is a serious matter that God tests and refines, much like silver is tried by fire (Psalms 66:10). Jesus teaches that divorce is only permissible in the case of fornication, warning that putting away one's spouse outside this cause leads to adultery (Matthew 5:32; 19:3,9). Furthermore, the brokenness that can arise in relationships may lead to betrayal and hatred (Matthew 24:10), yet believers are reminded that Christ is the true vine, sustaining and nurturing life in all relationships (John 15:1). This calls for a Christ-centered understanding of love’s trials and the sanctity of marriage under God's design.
